description: This file defines a final class TestCommand that extends AbstractCommand, representing a command object in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.base package. It includes method implementations for handling command properties such as entity ID, resource path, type, and headers, and provides a static factory method for JSON deserialization.

classes.name: TestCommand
classes.description: A command class that extends AbstractCommand, representing a specific command type with capabilities for JSON serialization/deserialization, and command metadata.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the provided JSON object builder based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix of the command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is QUERY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance of TestCommand with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with this command, here a default empty entity ID.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path as a JsonPointer, here an empty pointer.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type as a string, here an empty string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method to create a TestCommand instance from a JSON object and headers.
